- **Phase 2, build the candidate:** create the exact extraction manifest, run the full corpus, preserve all raw outputs, correct through zero-call replay, and seal one immutable candidate. Estimated 1 to 3 working days. Model calls take about 7 to 17 hours on two lanes.
